workload_summary: Mixed workload: interactive chat for support (multi-turn, avg 8 turns), real-time reranking (short inputs, high QPS), and online embeddings for search. Typical request size: chat 150-400 tokens, rerank 30-80 tokens. Daily traffic currently ~500k requests; projected growth 2.5x in 9 months.
requirements_summary: Hard SLOs: p95 latency below 600ms for chat first-token at steady-state; reranking p99 below 200ms; sustained token/sec guarantees for batch windows. Desired: predictable cost per 1M tokens under reserved contract. Operational: tracing hooks, per-route cost dashboards, and automatic fallback to hosted model if regional capacity constrained.
baseline_metrics: Observed steady-state: 40 QPS chat (avg 250 tokens/request) -> ~10k tokens/sec. Peak planning: short 15min bursts up to 280 QPS -> ~70k tokens/sec. Reranking: steady 120 QPS (avg 45 tokens) -> ~5.4k tokens/sec but p99 tight latency. Forecasted steady 3mo: 100 QPS steady across regions.
sla_expectations: Request: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pool, p95/p99 latency targets per route, financial credits for missed SLOs (sliding scale), maintenance windows limited to 1% monthly, runbook for failover to hosted backend. Negotiation points: acceptable MTTR, scheduled capacity scaling lead times, and data-eviction guarantees for KV cache on deprovision.
technical_wishlist: Autoscaling burst policy with warm spare nodes, GPU pinning per model family, per-request routing by latency vs cost, prefix KV cache reuse across short-lived sessions, telemetry export to Datadog/Splunk.
